title: Gavi's Zero-Dose Learning Hub IRMMA Aligned Interventions: Semiannual Update - Nigeria (October 2025)
why_not: Reports immunisation data-quality assessments and NHMIS timeliness in eight LGAs in the first half of 2025, before the twelve-month window; it does not say where data is keyed, which tiers report, or how many clinics enter their own reports.
